items.title: Consistency for mere mortals - A gentle guide to consistency
items.summary: This is a kind of foundational slide deck, introducing the most common concepts regarding consistency in a (hopefully) easily digestible way.It starts with explaining what consistency, constistency models, and anomalies are. Then it dives deeper into consistency models and presents several selected models. Afterwards, some common additional concepts are discussed that are associated with consistency, including a bit of myth-busting. Finally, a few recommendations and a list of the most widespread pitfalls regarding consistency are provided. All this is complemented by a relatively extensive list of references that provide deeper insights.As always, the voice track is missing (but there will be a recording from J On The Beach 2026 on YouTube). Still, I hope the deck provides a few useful ideas and pointers.
